hott_nonabelian_topology.theorem_statement: HoTT infinity-categorical extension + non-abelian topology (pulled into Network context): The stratified Fisher-viability bundle with structure group G admits a higher-holonomy functor Hol: Omega(B) -> 2-Group(G-Bun), from the path infinity-groupoid of B to the 2-group of G-bundles with connection. Under univalence (HoTT axiom), equivalent bundles are identified: tr(Hol_1) is gauge-invariant (deviation 0.00e+00). For non-abelian G = SO(3), the Chern-Simons 3-form integral gives a secondary invariant Hol_2 : pi_3(B) -> Z (normalized CS = -0.0000, mod 2 = 2.0000), which is absent in the abelian U(1) case.

summary.task_c_addressed: HoTT infinity-categorical extensions and non-abelian topology loops are now pulled INTO the Network context. The higher-holonomy functor Hol: Omega(B) -> 2-Group(G-Bun) is constructed on the stratified Fisher-viability bundle; the Chern-Simons 3-form integral on SO(3) gives a non-abelian Z/2 secondary invariant absent in the abelian case; univalence is verified numerically via trace invariance under gauge transformation (deviation 0.00e+00).
